name: Conductor
description: Run Orca as one conductor over long-lived coordinators and short-lived workers: roles, a question gate, model by role, and an org chart with sleep and wake. Coordinators are never deleted.

commands.title: Conductor: Make this workspace a coordinator workspace
Conductor: Make this workspace a worker workspace
Conductor: Make this workspace the conductor workspace

settings.title: Question gate
settings.description: Turn away AskUserQuestion from roles that may not ask the person, and point the agent at its coordinator.

settings.title: Roles that may ask the person
Model by role
settings.description: Add --model and --effort to a Claude launch from the policy below. An explicit --model or --effort always wins.

settings.title: Model policy
settings.description: role=alias:effort, separated by semicolons. Aliases only (opus, sonnet, haiku), never a full model id.

settings.title: Conductor title marker
settings.description: A chat whose title starts with this is the conductor.

settings.title: Coordinator title marker
settings.description: A chat whose title starts with this is a coordinator (chief of staff).

settings.title: Worker title marker
settings.description: A chat whose title starts with this is a worker another agent started.

settings.title: Home repo folder
settings.description: Absolute path of the home repo. Needed for the org chart, sleep and wake. Also passed to launched agents as CONDUCTOR_HOME.

settings.title: Coordinator script
settings.description: Absolute path of scripts/coordinator from the orca-conductor Claude Code plugin. The org chart, sleep and wake run it with python3.
